    "name": "What do hiring managers look for in a GitHub portfolio?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "Hiring managers look for more than technical execution. A strong GitHub portfolio demonstrates problem-solving ability, technical judgment, communication skills, and an understanding of real-world challenges. The most effective portfolios clearly explain why a project was built, the decisions made during development, and the value it creates for users or businesses."
    }
  },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "How many projects should be in a GitHub portfolio?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "There is no perfect number, but quality is typically more important than quantity. In most cases, three to five well-documented projects provide enough depth to showcase technical skills, decision-making, and growth. A smaller portfolio with strong context and clear relevance often makes a stronger impression than dozens of unfinished or poorly documented repositories."
    }
  },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "Is GitHub more important than a resume?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "No, a GitHub portfolio and resume serve different purposes. A resume provides a high-level overview of experience, skills, and accomplishments, while a portfolio offers evidence of how a candidate approaches technical work. Together, they help employers understand both a candidate’s background and their problem-solving capabilities."
    }
  },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "Should developers include AI projects in a GitHub portfolio?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "Yes, when those projects demonstrate meaningful technical thinking and real-world application. As tools like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, and Claude become increasingly common in software development, employers are often more interested in how candidates use AI effectively than whether they use it at all. Projects that showcase thoughtful implementation, evaluation of AI-generated solutions, and an understanding of tradeoffs can be particularly valuable."
    }
  }]

						<div class="Content_post">
							<p><span data-contrast="none">In today’s tech job market, recruiters and engineering leaders are reviewing an overwhelming number of applications. Many candidates have similar technical foundations, access to the same learning platforms, and experience building similar projects. Standing out often comes down to clarity, communication, and relevance.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none"><a href="https://soltech.net/advancing-your-tech-career-in-2026/">Technology has changed the hiring process</a>, but not the purpose of hiring. Companies still want people who can solve meaningful problems, communicate clearly, and contribute effectively within a team environment.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">I’ve seen talented developers build impressive applications that never fully resonate with hiring teams because the value behind the work is difficult to understand. The code may be strong, but the reasoning, decisions, and business impact are often missing from the story.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">That’s one reason many </span><span data-contrast="none">GitHub portfolios</span><span data-contrast="none"> fail to help candidates stand out. They showcase code without explaining the thinking behind it. Hiring managers are increasingly evaluating communication skills, technical judgment, and business impact, not just technical output. The strongest portfolios explain the problem being solved, the decisions made, and the value created.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></p>
<h2><b><span data-contrast="none">Why Don’t Recruiters Spend More Time Reviewing GitHub Portfolios?</span></b><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></h2>
<p><span data-contrast="none">Recruiters and hiring managers rarely have time to deeply evaluate every repository they open. Initial reviews are often fast, especially in a competitive hiring market where teams may be reviewing dozens or even hundreds of applications.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">That means your </span><span data-contrast="none">developer portfolio </span><span data-contrast="none">needs to communicate value immediately.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">Repository names, pinned projects, organization, and READMEs all shape first impressions before anyone looks at the code itself. If those elements feel unclear or disconnected, strong technical work can easily get overlooked.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<h3 aria-level="3"><b><span data-contrast="none">Clarity Creates Momentum</span></b><span data-ccp-props="{"134245418":true,"134245529":true,"335559738":160,"335559739":80}"> </span></h3>
<p><span data-contrast="none">The best portfolios answer important questions quickly:</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<ul>
<li aria-setsize="-1" data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="6" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">What problem does this project solve?</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li>
<li aria-setsize="-1" data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="6" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Why was it built?</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li>
<li aria-setsize="-1" data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="6" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Who benefits from it?</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li>
<li aria-setsize="-1" data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="6" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">What technical decisions mattered most?</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li>
<li aria-setsize="-1" data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="6" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">What challenges came up during development?</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li>
</ul>
<p><span data-contrast="none">Clear communication signals professionalism and technical maturity. It also makes it easier for recruiters, engineering managers, and executives to understand the relevance of the work.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">I often remind people that hiring teams should not have to reverse-engineer the purpose of a project. Strong portfolios guide the reader through the thinking behind the work.</span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">While GitHub remains one of the most common places employers review technical work, many organizations also look at personal portfolio websites, LinkedIn profiles, project demos, technical blogs, and open-source contributions when evaluating candidates. The same principle applies across all of them: clarity matters.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<h2><b><span data-contrast="none">Why Do Tutorial Projects Fail to Impress Hiring Managers?</span></b><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></h2>
<p><span data-contrast="none">Tutorial projects still serve an important purpose. They help developers learn frameworks, tools, and modern workflows. The challenge is that many portfolios stop there.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">Today’s hiring teams regularly see identical weather apps, ecommerce demos, task managers, and streaming platform clones across GitHub, LinkedIn, coding bootcamp portfolios, and technical applications.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">Those projects demonstrate exposure to technologies like React, Node.js, Next.js, or Python, but they do not always demonstrate independent thinking.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<h3 aria-level="3"><b><span data-contrast="none">Original Thinking Stands Out</span></b><span data-ccp-props="{"134245418":true,"134245529":true,"335559738":160,"335559739":80}"> </span></h3>
<p><span data-contrast="none">Projects become more compelling when candidates personalize them or apply them to real-world situations.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">Improving accessibility, refactoring architecture for scalability, integrating APIs in meaningful ways, or solving workflow challenges for a specific business all demonstrate initiative. Those changes help transform a project from a learning exercise into evidence of problem-solving.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">Hiring managers are not expecting every candidate to build a startup-level platform. They are looking for evidence of curiosity, adaptability, and ownership.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">Curiosity often reveals more about long-term potential than technical perfection ever could.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span> <img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" class="alignnone size-full wp-image-25246" src="https://soltech.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/github-image.jpg" alt="GitHub logo on corner of computer screen" width="1200" height="527" srcset="https://soltech.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/github-image.jpg 1200w, https://soltech.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/github-image-300x132.jpg 300w, https://soltech.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/github-image-1024x450.jpg 1024w, https://soltech.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/github-image-768x337.jpg 768w" sizes="(max-width: 1200px) 100vw, 1200px"></p>
<h2><b><span data-contrast="none">What Do Hiring Managers Actually Look For in a GitHub Portfolio?</span></b><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></h2>
<p><span data-contrast="none">Employers want to understand how candidates approach decisions.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">That means the reasoning behind a project is often just as important as the final product itself. Strong portfolios explain not only what was built, but why certain choices were made along the way.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">As AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, and Claude become more common in software development workflows, technical output alone no longer tells the full story of a candidate’s capabilities. Employers increasingly want to understand how candidates evaluate solutions, make tradeoffs, and apply technical knowledge to real business challenges.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></p>
<h3 aria-level="3"><b><span data-contrast="none">Technical Judgment Matters</span></b><span data-ccp-props="{"134245418":true,"134245529":true,"335559738":160,"335559739":80}"> </span></h3>
<p><span data-contrast="none">Strong portfolios often explain:</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<ul>
<li aria-setsize="-1" data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="8" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Why a particular tech stack was selected</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li>
<li aria-setsize="-1" data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="8" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">What constraints influenced development</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li>
<li aria-setsize="-1" data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="8" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Which tradeoffs had to be made</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li>
<li aria-setsize="-1" data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="8" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">What challenges slowed progress</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li>
<li aria-setsize="-1" data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="8" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">What improvements would come next</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li>
<li aria-setsize="-1" data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="8" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">What the developer learned during the process</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li>
</ul>
<p><span data-contrast="none">Those insights help hiring teams evaluate technical judgment, adaptability, and communication skills.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">I’ve noticed that candidates who openly discuss iteration and learning often leave a stronger impression than candidates presenting highly polished projects without explanation. Real-world software development is rarely perfect or linear.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">Acknowledging that reality demonstrates maturity and self-awareness.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<h2><b><span data-contrast="none">Why Does Context Matter in a Software Engineer Portfolio?</span></b><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></h2>
<p><span data-contrast="none">One of the biggest weaknesses in a </span><span data-contrast="none">software engineer portfolio</span><span data-contrast="none"> is the lack of meaningful context around projects.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p><div class="free-consultation-banner">
  <div class="banner-content-section">
	<p class="ad_head27">Join our team</p>
	<p>Are you looking to make a career move? Join us in making the world a better place through innovative software solutions.</p>

  </div>
  <div class="banner-image-section" style="background-image:url(/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/technical-consultant-soltech.webp)"></div>
  </div>
<p><span data-contrast="none">A weak README creates unnecessary friction for recruiters and hiring managers trying to evaluate technical work quickly. Even strong code can lose impact when the purpose of the project is unclear.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">A good README should explain both the technical and practical side of the project.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<h3 aria-level="3"><b><span data-contrast="none">Communication Builds Credibility</span></b><span data-ccp-props="{"134245418":true,"134245529":true,"335559738":160,"335559739":80}"> </span></h3>
<p><span data-contrast="none">Helpful READMEs often include:</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<ul>
<li aria-setsize="-1" data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="9" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">The problem being solved</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li>
<li aria-setsize="-1" data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="9" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">The intended users</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li>
<li aria-setsize="-1" data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="9" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Key technical decisions</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li>
<li aria-setsize="-1" data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="9" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Screenshots or workflow examples</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li>

<li aria-setsize="-1" data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="9" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Future improvements</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li>
<li aria-setsize="-1" data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="9" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Lessons learned during development</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li>
</ul>
<p><span data-contrast="none">This matters because technical hiring is rarely evaluated by engineers alone. Recruiters, HR leaders, executives, and engineering managers may all review a portfolio at different stages.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none"><a href="https://soltech.net/importance-of-leadership-soft-skills/">Communication skills</a> are part of technical credibility.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">Candidates who explain their work clearly demonstrate that they can collaborate across teams and connect technical decisions to broader business goals.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">Clarity builds confidence on both sides of the hiring process.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<h2><b><span data-contrast="none">How Can You Make Your Projects More Relevant to Employers?</span></b><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></h2>
<p><span data-contrast="none">The strongest projects connect technical work to practical outcomes.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">That does not mean every project needs to solve a massive global problem. In many cases, smaller projects feel more compelling because the relevance is easier to understand immediately.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">For example, a workflow automation tool for a local business may stand out more than a generic social media clone because the business value is clear.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<h3 aria-level="3"><b><span data-contrast="none">Relevance Creates Differentiation</span></b><span data-ccp-props="{"134245418":true,"134245529":true,"335559738":160,"335559739":80}"> </span></h3>
<p><span data-contrast="none">The projects that stand out often demonstrate improved efficiency, better usability, simplified workflows, reduced friction, or solutions to operational challenges.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">Projects also become stronger when they align with the type of role a candidate wants.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">A backend engineer might emphasize APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, or scalability. A frontend developer may focus on accessibility, responsive design, and user experience. Candidates pursuing AI, cybersecurity, or DevOps roles should tailor projects toward the tools and workflows commonly used in those fields.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">Over time, I’ve learned that the most effective portfolios are rarely the biggest. They’re the clearest.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></p>
<h2><b><span data-contrast="none">What Makes a Strong GitHub Portfolio?</span></b><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></h2>
<p><span data-contrast="none">A strong </span><span data-contrast="none">GitHub portfolio</span><span data-contrast="none"> is not about having the most repositories or the most advanced applications. It is about helping employers understand how you think.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></p>
<h3 aria-level="3"><b><span data-contrast="none">Best Practices for Building a Strong GitHub Portfolio</span></b><span data-ccp-props="{"134245418":true,"134245529":true,"335551550":0,"335551620":0,"335559738":160,"335559739":80}"> </span></h3>
<p><span data-contrast="none">A strong GitHub portfolio typically includes:</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></p>
<ul>
<li aria-setsize="-1" data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="11" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559683":0,"335559684":-2,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Three to five well-documented projects</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335551550":0,"335551620":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li>
<li aria-setsize="-1" data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="11" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559683":0,"335559684":-2,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Clear README documentation</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335551550":0,"335551620":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li>
<li aria-setsize="-1" data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="11" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559683":0,"335559684":-2,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Screenshots, demos, or videos</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335551550":0,"335551620":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li>
<li aria-setsize="-1" data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="11" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559683":0,"335559684":-2,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Technical architecture explanations</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335551550":0,"335551620":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li>
<li aria-setsize="-1" data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="11" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559683":0,"335559684":-2,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Business or user impact</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335551550":0,"335551620":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li>
<li aria-setsize="-1" data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="11" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559683":0,"335559684":-2,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Evidence of iteration and improvement</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335551550":0,"335551620":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li>
<li aria-setsize="-1" data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="11" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559683":0,"335559684":-2,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Lessons learned during development</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335551550":0,"335551620":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li>
<li aria-setsize="-1" data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="11" data-list-defn-props="{"335552541":1,"335559683":0,"335559684":-2,"335559685":720,"335559991":360,"469769226":"Symbol","469769242":[8226],"469777803":"left","469777804":"","469777815":"hybridMultilevel"}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Future enhancement plans</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335551550":0,"335551620":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":0}"> </span></li>
</ul>
<p><span data-contrast="none">The portfolios that stand out make reasoning visible. They explain decisions, highlight learning, and connect technical work to real-world value.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">Over the years, I’ve found that the portfolios that leave the strongest impression aren’t necessarily the most complex. They’re the ones that help employers understand how challenges were approached and why certain decisions were made.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">Technical skills still matter, but they rarely tell the whole story. In <a href="https://soltech.net/if-youre-a-software-engineer-in-2026/">today’s hiring market</a>, communication, context, and technical judgment often become the differentiators that move candidates forward.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">At the end of the day, employers are not simply hiring developers who can write code. They are hiring people who can solve problems, collaborate effectively, and continue learning as technology evolves.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></p>
<h2 aria-level="2"><b><span data-contrast="none">FAQs</span></b><span data-ccp-props="{"134245418":true,"134245529":true,"335559738":160,"335559739":80}"> </span></h2>
<h3 aria-level="3"><b><span data-contrast="none">What do hiring managers look for in a GitHub portfolio?</span></b><span data-ccp-props="{"134245418":true,"134245529":true,"335551550":0,"335551620":0,"335559738":160,"335559739":80}"> </span></h3>
<p><span data-contrast="none">Hiring managers look for more than technical execution. A strong </span><span data-contrast="none">GitHub portfolio </span><span data-contrast="none">demonstrates problem-solving ability, technical judgment, communication skills, and an understanding of real-world challenges. The most effective portfolios clearly explain why a project was built, the decisions made during development, and the value it creates for users or businesses.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></p>
<h3 aria-level="3"><b><span data-contrast="none">How many projects should be in a GitHub portfolio?</span></b><span data-ccp-props="{"134245418":true,"134245529":true,"335551550":0,"335551620":0,"335559738":160,"335559739":80}"> </span></h3>
<p><span data-contrast="none">There is no perfect number, but quality is typically more important than quantity. In most cases, three to five well-documented projects provide enough depth to showcase technical skills, decision-making, and growth. A smaller portfolio with strong context and clear relevance often makes a stronger impression than dozens of unfinished or poorly documented repositories.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></p>
<h3 aria-level="3"><b><span data-contrast="none">Is GitHub more important than a resume?</span></b><span data-ccp-props="{"134245418":true,"134245529":true,"335551550":0,"335551620":0,"335559738":160,"335559739":80}"> </span></h3>
<p><span data-contrast="none">No, a </span><span data-contrast="none">GitHub portfolio</span><span data-contrast="none"> and resume serve different purposes. A resume provides a high-level overview of experience, skills, and accomplishments, while a portfolio offers evidence of how a candidate approaches technical work. Together, they help employers understand both a candidate’s background and their problem-solving capabilities.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></p>
<h3 aria-level="3"><b><span data-contrast="none">Should developers include AI projects in a GitHub portfolio?</span></b><span data-ccp-props="{"134245418":true,"134245529":true,"335551550":0,"335551620":0,"335559738":160,"335559739":80}"> </span></h3>
<p><span data-contrast="none">Yes, when those projects demonstrate meaningful technical thinking and real-world application. As tools like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, and Claude become increasingly common in software development, employers are often more interested in how candidates use AI effectively than whether they use it at all. Projects that showcase thoughtful implementation, evaluation of AI-generated solutions, and an understanding of tradeoffs can be particularly valuable.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":0,"335551620":0}"> </span></p>

<script type="rocketlazyloadscript">
// List of parameters to capture
const allowedParams = [
  'utm_source', 'utm_medium', 'utm_campaign', 'utm_term', 'utm_content',
  'gclid', 'fbclid', 'gad_source', 'cpn', 'kw'
];

// Detect crawlers to skip client-side link mutation
const isCrawler = /LumarBot|Googlebot|Bingbot|Slurp|DuckDuckBot/.test(navigator.userAgent);

// Get UTM params from URL
function getUTMParamsFromURL() {
  const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const params = {};
  let found = false;
  allowedParams.forEach(key => {
    if (urlParams.has(key)) {
      params[key] = urlParams.get(key);
      found = true;
    }
  });
  return found ? params : null;
}

// Read UTM params from cookies
function getRelevantCookies() {
  return document.cookie.split(';').reduce((acc, cookie) => {
    const [rawKey, rawValue] = cookie.trim().split('=');
    const key = decodeURIComponent(rawKey);
    const value = decodeURIComponent(rawValue);
    if (allowedParams.includes(key)) acc[key] = value;
    return acc;
  }, {});
}

// Persist UTM params to cookies (30 days)
function setCookies(params) {
  const maxAge = 30 * 24 * 60 * 60;
  Object.entries(params).forEach(([key, value]) => {
    if (!document.cookie.includes(`${key}=${value}`)) {
      document.cookie = `${key}=${encodeURIComponent(value)}; path=/; domain=.soltech.net; max-age=${maxAge}`;
    }
  });
}

// Update internal links with UTM params
function updateInternalLinks(params) {
  if (!params || Object.keys(params).length === 0 || isCrawler) return;
  const links = document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="/"]:not([data-utm-processed])');
  links.forEach(link => {
    const url = new URL(link.href, location.origin);
    Object.entries(params).forEach(([k, v]) => {
      if (!url.searchParams.has(k)) url.searchParams.set(k, v);
    });
    link.href = url.toString();
    link.setAttribute('data-utm-processed', '1');
  });
}

// Populate hidden form fields with UTM values
function populateFormFields(params) {
  if (!params) return;
  Object.entries(params).forEach(([key, value]) => {
    const input = document.querySelector(`input[name="${key}"]`);
    if (input) input.value = value;
  });
}

// Main: capture & store on first interaction, then update links/forms
function manageUTM() {
  const urlParams = getUTMParamsFromURL();
  const params = urlParams || getRelevantCookies();
  if (urlParams) setCookies(urlParams);
  populateFormFields(params);
  updateInternalLinks(params);
}

// Init on first user interaction (mouse or scroll)
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  if (!isCrawler) {
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', manageUTM, { once: true });
    document.addEventListener('scroll', manageUTM, { once: true });
  }
});
</script>

		// Helper function to create and initialize a mega menu
		function initializeMegaMenu(targetElement) {
			// Create mega menu wrapper
			const megaMenu = document.createElement('div');
			megaMenu.classList.add('custom-mega-menu');
			megaMenu.innerHTML = `
				<div class="mega-left">
					<ul></ul>
				</div>
				<div class="mega-right">
					<div class="mega-grid"></div>
				</div>
			`;

			// Attach + show/hide behavior
			megaMenu.style.display = 'none';

			targetElement.style.position = 'relative';
			targetElement.appendChild(megaMenu);

			// Desktop: Use hover behavior
			targetElement.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
				megaMenu.style.display = 'flex';	
			});
			targetElement.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
				megaMenu.style.display = 'none';
			});

			const leftMenu = megaMenu.querySelector('.mega-left ul');
			const grid = megaMenu.querySelector('.mega-grid');

			// Render items (right panel)
			function renderSection(section) {
				grid.innerHTML = "";

				section.items.forEach(({ img, title, desc, link }) => {
					const item = document.createElement('a');
					item.classList.add('mega-item');
					item.href = link || "#";
					item.innerHTML = `
						<img src="${img}" alt="${title}" class="mega-icon" />
						<div>
							<strong style="font-size: 15px;">${title}</strong>
							<p class="megaMenuText">${desc}</p>
						</div>
					`;
					grid.appendChild(item);
				});

				leftMenu.querySelectorAll('li').forEach(li => li.classList.remove('active'));
				leftMenu.querySelector(`[data-section="${section.name}"]`)?.classList.add('active');
			}

			// Populate left menu (with links)
			sections.forEach((section, i) => {
				const li = document.createElement('li');
				li.setAttribute('data-section', section.name);

				const a = document.createElement('a');
				a.textContent = section.name;
				a.href = section.url || "#";
				li.appendChild(a);

				if (i === 0) li.classList.add('active');
				li.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => renderSection(section));

				leftMenu.appendChild(li);
			});

			// Default load first section
			renderSection(sections[0]);
		}	//initializeMegaMenu - End

		// Initialize desktop mega menu (with hover behavior)
		initializeMegaMenu(target);

		// Add chevrons to mobile menu items (About, Learning Center, Careers)
		const chevronSVG = '<svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" data-prefix="fas" data-icon="chevron-down" class="svg-inline--fa fa-chevron-down fa-w-14" role="img" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 448 512" style="width: 14px; height: 14px; margin-left: 8px; transition: transform 0.3s ease;"><path fill="currentColor" d="M207.029 381.476L12.686 187.132c-9.373-9.373-9.373-24.569 0-33.941l22.667-22.667c9.357-9.357 24.522-9.375 33.901-.04L224 284.505l154.745-154.021c9.379-9.335 24.544-9.317 33.901.04l22.667 22.667c9.373 9.373 9.373 24.569 0 33.941L240.971 381.476c-9.373 9.372-24.569 9.372-33.942 0z"></path></svg>';
		
		// Add chevrons to mobile menu items with sub-menus in #menu-header-menuaabout-1
		const mobileMenuSelectors = [
			'#menu-header-menuaabout-1 > .about-menu',
			'#menu-header-menuaabout-1 > .insight-menu',
			'#menu-header-menuaabout-1 > .career-menu'
		];
		
		mobileMenuSelectors.forEach(selector => {
			const menuItem = document.querySelector(selector);
			if (menuItem) {
				const link = menuItem.querySelector(':scope > a');
				if (link && !link.querySelector('svg[data-icon="chevron-down"]')) {
					// Get current text and append chevron
					const currentText = link.textContent;
					link.innerHTML = currentText + chevronSVG;
				}
			}
		});
		
		// Watch for submenu display changes and rotate chevrons accordingly
		const observeSubmenus = () => {
			const menuItems = [
				{ selector: '#menu-header-menuaabout-1 > .about-menu', name: 'ABOUT' },
				{ selector: '#menu-header-menuaabout-1 > .insight-menu', name: 'LEARNING CENTER' },
				{ selector: '#menu-header-menuaabout-1 > .career-menu', name: 'CAREERS' }
			];
			
			// Store previous states
			const previousStates = {};
			
			menuItems.forEach(({ selector, name }) => {
				const menuItem = document.querySelector(selector);
				if (!menuItem) return;
				
				const subMenu = menuItem.querySelector(':scope > .sub-menu');
				const chevron = menuItem.querySelector(':scope > a svg[data-icon="chevron-down"]');
				
				if (!subMenu || !chevron) return;
				
				// Initialize previous state
				previousStates[name] = null;
				
				// Function to check and update chevron
				const updateChevron = () => {
					const computedStyle = window.getComputedStyle(subMenu);
					const isVisible = computedStyle.display === 'block';
					
					// Only update if state changed
					if (previousStates[name] !== isVisible) {
						previousStates[name] = isVisible;
						
						if (isVisible) {
							chevron.style.transform = 'rotate(180deg)';
						} else {
							chevron.style.transform = 'rotate(0deg)';
						}
					}
				};
				
				// Create a MutationObserver to watch for changes
				const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
					updateChevron();
				});
				
				// Start observing the submenu for style and class changes
				observer.observe(subMenu, {
					attributes: true,
					attributeFilter: ['style', 'class']
				});
				
				// ALSO set up polling as a fallback (check every 100ms)
				setInterval(updateChevron, 100);
				
				// Check initial state
				updateChevron();
			});
		};
		
		// Run after a short delay to ensure DOM is ready
		setTimeout(observeSubmenus, 200);

		// Add CSS to prevent menu items from wrapping
		const noWrapStyle = document.createElement('style');
		noWrapStyle.textContent = `
			/* Prevent menu items with chevrons from wrapping */
			#menu-header-menuaabout-1 > li > a {
				white-space: nowrap !important;
				display: inline-flex !important;
				align-items: center !important;
			}
			
			#menu-header-menuaabout-1 > li > a svg {
				flex-shrink: 0 !important;
			}
			
			/* Ensure parent menu items don't wrap */
			#menu-header-menuaabout-1 > li {
				overflow: visible !important;
			}
		`;
		document.head.appendChild(noWrapStyle);

		// Add click handlers to above-desk menu links to toggle sub-menus
		const aboveDeskLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.above-desk .Nav_link.Link_one');
		
		aboveDeskLinks.forEach((link, index) => {
			link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
				e.preventDefault();
				e.stopPropagation();
				
				// Find the parent Nav_item
				const parentItem = this.closest('.Nav_item');
				if (!parentItem) return;
				
				// Find the sub-menu
				const subMenu = parentItem.querySelector(':scope > .Sub_menu_one');
				if (!subMenu) return;
				
				// Find the chevron SVG
				const chevron = this.querySelector('svg[data-icon="chevron-down"]');
				
				// Check if currently open
				const isOpen = subMenu.style.display === 'block';
				
				// Close all other sub-menus first (accordion behavior)
				document.querySelectorAll('.above-desk .Sub_menu_one').forEach(menu => {
					if (menu !== subMenu) {
						menu.style.display = 'none';
					}
				});
				
				// Reset all chevrons
				document.querySelectorAll('.above-desk svg[data-icon="chevron-down"]').forEach(svg => {
					if (svg !== chevron) {
						svg.style.transform = 'rotate(0deg)';
					}
				});
				
				// Toggle this sub-menu
				if (isOpen) {
					subMenu.style.display = 'none';
					if (chevron) chevron.style.transform = 'rotate(0deg)';
				} else {
					subMenu.style.display = 'block';
					if (chevron) chevron.style.transform = 'rotate(180deg)';
				}
			});
		});
			
	});	//DOMContentLoaded - End
</script>
